hostname.description: host label / SNI matched. Required unless catchall (enforced in code); a catch-all has no SNI to declare.

tls.description: terminate (default): ACME TLS terminated and reverse-proxied to port. passthrough: raw TLS forwarded by SNI to port; backend owns its TLS.

catchall.description: at most one per host; matches all unmatched SNIs; implies passthrough

proxy_protocol.description: send the PROXY protocol header to the upstream on passthrough/catchall routes so the backend learns the real client address
